name: Elin Rhys
bio: Elin's passion for motorsport ignited during her childhood, spent watching rally races in the Welsh countryside. After earning a degree in Marketing from Cardiff University, she interned with a local racing team, quickly proving her ability to connect with fans and sponsors alike. Elin is driven by the desire to elevate Rexal FMI Racing's brand presence and build lasting relationships with key stakeholders. She approaches her role with a blend of creativity and data-driven insights, always seeking innovative ways to engage audiences. Her meticulous planning and proactive communication have already made her a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair, often pulled back into a high ponytail during events.
physical.description: Elin is of average height, with a slender build and a perpetually bright expression.

quirks: Always has a meticulously organized spreadsheet for every marketing campaign.
Carries a small notebook filled with marketing ideas that she jots down at random moments.
Has a lucky Rexal FMI Racing keychain that she always keeps on her.
